local m = workspace:FindFirstChild('_TEST_A15_lamp_v2')
if not m then return 'lamp not found' end
local P = { iron={40,38,37,'Metal',0}, brass={178,138,66,'Metal',0}, glass_lit={240,170,90,'Glass',0.35}, glow={255,176,90,'Neon',0} }
local out = {}
for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
  if d:IsA('MeshPart') then
    local p = P[d.Name]
    if p then
      d.Color = Color3.fromRGB(p[1], p[2], p[3])
      d.Material = Enum.Material[p[4]]
      d.Transparency = p[5]
      d.Anchored = true
      if d.Name == 'glow' and not d:FindFirstChildOfClass('PointLight') then
        local l = Instance.new('PointLight'); l.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,190,120); l.Range = 22; l.Brightness = 1.6; l.Shadows = true; l.Parent = d
      end
      table.insert(out, d.Name..' -> '..d.Material.Name..' '..tostring(d.Color))
    else table.insert(out, d.Name..' -> NO PALETTE ENTRY') end
  end
end
local cf, sz = m:GetBoundingBox()
return table.concat(out, '\n')..'\nbottom y='..string.format('%.2f', cf.Position.Y - sz.Y/2)..' at x=20 z=70'
